description: 'Value and Momentum Everywhere' found 12-1 momentum across asset classes, not just stocks. Approximation: rank 16 asset ETFs on 12-month return excluding the last month and hold the top 4. Falsified if it does not beat an equal-weight mix of the same ETFs.
title: Cross-asset momentum 12-1 · top 4 of 16 ETFs (after Asness, Moskowitz & Pedersen 2013)
